name: 🎮 Game (Unity 6 / Blender 3D / Mesh & Asset Optimization)
description: Cấu hình chuyên sâu cho phát triển Game 3D: kiểm toán rò rỉ bộ nhớ MonoBehaviour/C# delegates, triệt tiêu GC allocations trong Update(), tối ưu DrawCall batching, kiểm soát topology/polygon count trong Blender 4.x và kết nối MCP Unity/Blender.
description_en: 3D game development: MonoBehaviour/C# delegate leak audits, zero GC allocations in Update(), DrawCall batching, Blender 4.x topology/polygon budgets and Unity/Blender MCP integration.
external_mcps_note: Unity/Blender MCP servers are not shipped in mcp/; install and register them yourself. They are not checked by agent-kit health.
